desc: Ideate the core algorithm: Iterate roots, sort neighbor degrees, maximize $1 + j \cdot D_j$.

Implement the solution in Python using the derived $O(N \log N)$ algorithm: iterate each vertex as a potential root, sort its neighbors' degrees, and calculate the maximum kept nodes for each valid configuration of $x$ and $y$.
Test with provided samples (Sample 1, 2, 3) to verify logic and edge cases.
